features: Search the plugin catalog, view package details and READMEs, and install plugins with a choice of version and download source.
Enable or disable installed plugins, choose update channels, and install, update, or remove multiple plugins at once.
Sign in to supported model-provider accounts from Settings and select account models to add to your model list.
Choose whether the desktop configuration window appears at startup, hides when opening chat, or returns when closing chat.
added: Docker deployment for Linux amd64, with a bundled runtime, persistent data mounts, and setup, upgrade, and backup documentation.
changed: Plugin maintenance waits for active calls to the affected plugin to finish before applying changes; locked files may still require a restart.

The pidesk plugin commands support multiple install/remove targets, channel selection with --tag, and explicit update checks with --check-updates. Existing plugins follow their saved channel when no version or channel is specified.
Desktop setup shows per-component installation and download progress and prepares Pi and Pi Desk in parallel after Node.js is ready.
Desktop settings and remote-access controls are reorganized, with connection status and address copying on a dedicated remote-access page. The header shows the installed desktop app version.
Desktop startup update checks run after the installed service is ready rather than delaying startup, and newly available updates bring the configuration window into view.
Creating a session opens the directory browser automatically when no project directories are listed, and keeps the current directory listing visible while navigating.
fixed: Keep built-in message content visible while plugin views load or fail, and show loading details instead of blank placeholders for plugin-only messages.
Defer session reloads while a native plugin prompt is awaiting an answer.
Fix tunnel initialization overflow on 32-bit platforms.
breaking: Plugin SDK dropdowns now use the options-based PluginSelect API. PluginSelectField and the previous native-select PluginSelect API are no longer available; plugin authors must update their imports and props.
